verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm that Stripe serves an llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, 'Stripe Documentation' with agent-directed instructions). They also confirm agent-friendly markdown versions of the Identity docs at identity.md and related .md pages, so an agent can be pointed directly at them. Missing for 10: no evidence that llms.txt specifically indexes Identity content, and no first-party documentation describing the llms.txt and .md offering for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stripe.com/llms.txt # Stripe Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stripe.com/identity.md # Identity
